card.text: TOI-5624 e was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-5624 e"
sources.quote: TOI-5624 e is the fourth and the second largest exoplanet discovered in the TOI-5624 system, located approximately 331 light-years from Earth in the constellation Ursa Major.

introduction.text: It is one of 5 planets known around TOI-5624. Its orbit and size follow Bonfanti et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-5624 e"
sources.quote: The discovery of the object was officially announced by an international team of astronomers led by Andrea Bonfant in late April 2026.
